rules.logic: Anchors on BIOC(MP-019 Web-Service Process Spawns Interactive Shell After Injection Exploit) — the exploit foothold whose causality_actor_process is the www-data web service — and groups on agent_hostname + causality_id + causality_actor_process_instance_id. Within a 1800s window it requires the chain to bind to that SAME causality actor: upstream the NDR recon burst BIOC(MP-019 External Port-and-Service Scan Burst Against Exposed Host) and the web content-discovery fan-out XQL from the same source, then downstream BIOC(MP-019 Credential Brute-Force Child Spawned From Web-Service Shell) and ABIOC(MP-019 Anomalous Lateral Authentication Burst From Web Host) — the shared_entity credential pivot that carries the incident from the web host to the Domain Controller. Fires exactly ONE ANALYTICS incident that reconstructs the full lineage operator-recon(CGO) -> web-enum -> injection-shell(www-data) -> hydra/netexec brute -> impacket lateral, so five planes of individually low-severity tool signal surface as one external-to-internal intrusion instead of a disconnected star of scanner alerts.
rules.name: MP-019 Kali External-to-Internal Kill-Chain Stitch
